unstable ranking and high error correlation favor robust median of the most stable models
pruned redundant pool reduces correlated error and unstable ranking favors robust trimmed mean

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 13 backtested attempts, score 0.6833. Series context: trend strength 0.1729 and seasonal strength 0.499; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.092); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.491.
